about_short_description.short_description: Positional is a toolset for content teams to scale their content channels faster and drive more traffic from organic search.

product.name: Content Gap Analysis Tool
product.description: A tool that compares a website's keyword rankings against competitors to identify missed keyword opportunities for content creation and optimization.

product.name: Internals Toolset
product.description: A toolset that identifies internal linking opportunities across a website to improve site structure and help Google crawl and index pages more effectively.

product.name: Content Optimization Toolset
product.description: A toolset that analyzes content to recommend relevant keywords, phrases, and topics to include for improved on-page SEO and search engine rankings.

product.name: Keyword Clustering Tool
product.description: A tool that groups keywords based on search engine results page (SERP) data to help organize keywords by topic and search intent for content planning.

product.name: Content Analytics Toolset
product.description: A toolset that provides detailed user engagement metrics and heatmaps for website content to identify areas for improvement and enhance user experience.
